title: P1.11a3 Add the typed control-room goal-brief command edge
description: Consume the shared brief contract and the existing generated goal.create affordance builder in a focused control-room-client helper. The helper accepts user prose and transport metadata only, normalizes through the shared codec, and builds the real runtime envelope exclusively from a daemon-minted affordance.
definitionOfDone: Verify-or-block first: re-measure the landed goal-brief contract, the generated goal.create builder, and the @moe/control-room-client dependency edge to @moe/contracts in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml; prove a temporary bare-specifier import typechecks.

The public helper accepts only title, instructions, correlation id, request digest, session credential, and a daemon-issued goal.create affordance; it exposes no actor, project, run, budget, witness, authority, command id, version, or target setters.

Valid input is normalized by the shared contract and passed to the production generated goal.create builder; the resulting envelope takes command identity, target, and expected version only from the affordance.

Missing, malformed, oversized, or extra brief input refuses with the shared stable contract evidence instead of trimming, dropping, or inventing fields; focused tests include hostile authority extras and pin the refusal.

The @moe/control-room-client focused tests and typecheck run standalone with exit 0 and nonzero Vitest count lines, and a production-helper mutation makes the named authority assertion red before restoration.
